name: Glycine
evidence_snapshot: Small human crossover trials report improvements in selected subjective sleep and next-day measures at 3 g; GlyNAC findings concern a separate combination.

name: Magnesium bisglycinate
evidence_snapshot: A four-week RCT reported a small improvement in subjective insomnia severity at 250 mg/day elemental magnesium; form-specific evidence remains limited.

name: Creatine monohydrate
evidence_snapshot: Strong evidence supports repeated high-intensity exercise performance; cognition trials report mixed domain-specific results depending on population and dose.

name: Taurine
evidence_snapshot: A randomized trial in prehypertension and a small pooled analysis reported modest blood-pressure changes at studied gram-scale doses.

name: Choline
evidence_snapshot: An essential nutrient with recognized metabolic roles; small prenatal feeding studies report selected offspring outcomes, not adult memory enhancement.

name: L-5-methyltetrahydrofolate
evidence_snapshot: An active folate form studied for homocysteine lowering and as high-dose psychiatric adjunct in specific populations; outcomes are context-specific.

name: Vitamin B12
evidence_snapshot: Essential for normal nervous-system function and blood-cell formation; deficiency correction is established, while cognitive enhancement without deficiency is unproven.

name: Vitamin D3
evidence_snapshot: Supports established calcium, bone, muscle and immune nutritional functions; VITAL did not show broad primary cancer/CVD prevention in generally healthy adults.

name: Vitamin K2 MK-7
evidence_snapshot: Vitamin K supports normal clotting and bones; selected MK-7 trials report changes in bone or vascular surrogate markers, not clinical events.

name: Trimethylglycine
evidence_snapshot: Controlled trials report homocysteine lowering at studied gram-scale betaine doses; this biomarker outcome is not proof of event prevention.

name: Nicotinamide riboside
evidence_snapshot: Human trials consistently report increased selected NAD-related metabolites; longer-term functional and clinical outcomes require more research.

name: Coenzyme Q10
evidence_snapshot: A controlled adjunctive heart-failure trial reported fewer long-term clinical events in its specific patient population; not established for general longevity.

name: Pyrroloquinoline quinone
evidence_snapshot: Small 12-week trials reported improvements in selected computerized cognitive measures; independent replication and endpoint clarity are needed.

name: Spermidine
evidence_snapshot: Human cognitive and exposure studies have been conducted; SmartAge did not meet its primary memory endpoint at 0.9 mg/day.

name: Quercetin
evidence_snapshot: Meta-analyses report small pooled blood-pressure changes in selected trials and subgroups; no clinical-event benefit established.

name: Trans-resveratrol
evidence_snapshot: Human trials report some metabolic or imaging surrogate signals alongside neutral results; clinical and longevity outcomes remain uncertain.

name: Calcium alpha-ketoglutarate
evidence_snapshot: Preclinical findings motivate human aging research and the ABLE protocol; completed clinical healthy-aging efficacy is not established in this selected index.
